Target: SkyWater 130nm (sky130_fd_sc_hd) on Tiny Tapeout 2x2 Tile
Placement Target Density: Set to 0.65 (65.0%) for optimal cell packing
with 35.0% whitespace for routing channels and buffer insertion.

Routing: Restrict detailed routing to met1..met4 (met5 reserved for power grid / mux)
Floorplan sizing defined by Tiny Tapeout tile boundaries
Decap cells for power integrity (V = I * R drop suppression)
Do not buffer output ports (avoids extra clock delays on external pads)
Blackbox cell libraries for Sky130 primitives
